# telnyx_external_connection_releases (Data Source)

The requests to release phone numbers from an external connection.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object whose items are listed.

### Optional

- `filter_civic_address_id` (String) The civic address ID to filter by
- `filter_location_id` (String) The location ID to filter by
- `filter_phone_number` (String) The phone number to filter by
- `filter_phone_number_contains` (String) The partial phone number to filter by. Requires 3-15 digits.
- `filter_status` (List of String) The status of the release to filter by
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `external_connection_releases` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_connection_releases))

<a id="nestedatt--external_connection_releases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_connection_releases`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `error_message` (String) A message set if there is an error with the upload process.
- `status` (String) Represents the status of the release on Microsoft Teams.
- `telephone_numbers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_connection_releases--telephone_numbers))
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `ticket_id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--external_connection_releases--telephone_numbers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_connection_releases.telephone_numbers`

Read-Only:

- `number_id` (String) Phone number ID from the Telnyx API.
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number in E164 format.
